analyst_insights: Key numbers: 5,884 (Spend, the 12 months to 2025-12; -0.1% against the 12 months to 2024-12); 441.18 (Spend, 2025-11; -11.3% on 2024-11); 651.85 (Peak, 2025-05; the last value is -32.3% from it).
The total of spend fell from 5,893 in the 12 months to 2024-12 to 5,884 in the 12 months to 2025-12 (-0.1%).
In 2025-11, spend fell to 441.18 from 497.58 in 2024-11 (-11.3% year on year); the three months from 2025-09 moved the same way (-2.3% on a year earlier).
Over 23 months (2024-01 to 2025-11) spend shows no clear straight-line trend (95% range -1.75 to +6.02 a month).
23 of 230 relative changes from one date to the next in spend (10.0%) sit far from the rest (robust z beyond 3.5); the furthest out is the largest, +17-fold (2025-12-06) against a median of -5.1%.
